item: Mini quartz clock insert, 1-3/8" (35 mm) fit-up
description: Press-in quartz clock movement with its own dial, hands and button cell, made for a 35 mm (1-3/8") hole: 35 mm body, a bezel of about 36-38 mm, 15-20 mm deep including the setting knob. White dial, black numerals.
where_to_buy: Clock-making and woodworking suppliers (Klockit, Rockler, Woodcraft), craft stores, Amazon or eBay: search for "1-3/8 inch mini clock insert" or "35 mm clock insert".
